note: An ordering of reports by the factors configured below. It is not a finding about need, not a measure of how serious anything is, and not a statement about how public money should be spent. Every figure behind it is team-created synthetic data.
budget_assumption: No budget, cost, capacity or delivery-time information is used anywhere in this ordering. It does not sequence spending, cannot say what is affordable, and does not know what any of this would cost.
existing_project_rationale: a confirmed sanctioned project suggests work is already planned for this asset, so this deployment lowers it rather than raising it — the opposite reading, that a funded asset which is still broken is a repeat failure, is equally defensible and is why this is configured rather than assumed

weightings.label: Balanced
weightings.rationale: no single factor is treated as decisive

weightings.label: Equity-led
weightings.rationale: wards that report less are treated as under-served rather than untroubled

weightings.label: Waiting-led
weightings.rationale: how long people have already waited is treated as the strongest claim

weightings.label: Reach-led
weightings.rationale: how many people a fix would reach is treated as the strongest claim
